newsitem.title: USA: USCI names Mario Martinez president, COO.
newsitem.headline: USCI names Mario Martinez president, COO.

text.p: USCI Inc said Monday it had named Mario Martinez as president and chief operating officer, effective immediately.
The company said Martinez is the former president of AT&T Corp's Florida consumer markets division.
It said in a written statement that Martinez joins Bruce Hahn, who has served as both chairman and president since USCI's inception.
Hahn will continue as chairman and chief executive.
USCI officials were not available to provide furtner details.
